description: This file contains integration tests for loan delinquency behavior, specifically focusing on the calculation of next payment due dates in different scenarios involving partial payments, charges after maturity date, and configuration changes. It extends a base test class and uses JUnit 5 for testing, with multiple helper classes to manage loans, clients, and configurations.

classes.name: LoanDelinquencyDetailsNextPaymentDateConfigurationTest
classes.description: Integration test class extending BaseLoanIntegrationTest to verify loan delinquency and next payment date logic under various configurations and payment scenarios.

methods.name: verifyLoanDelinquencyNextPaymentDate
methods.description: Checks the next payment due date or its null status for a given loan on a specific business date.

methods.name: createLoanProductWith25PctDownPaymentAndDelinquencyBucket
methods.description: Creates a loan product configured with a specific down payment percentage and delinquency bucket settings, returning its ID.
